rows.en: Ah! Don't pull me!!
rows.notes: Luis drags the player off to his party.

rows.en:
(Is this one of those 'the more they fight,
the closer they are' things...?)

Don't stop me, Fresh Girl...
There are times when a man...
just has to fight, y'know?
You're a teacher, Gary-sensei!
Don't joke like that, Pretty Girl...
rows.notes: Female version of c01677; Luis's 'puritii gaaru'.

rows.en:
Give me a break!
Fresh Girl or not, there are things you can say
and things you can't, y'know?

No, Fresh Girl,
you must choose...
A future with me, or a future with him...
...Fresh Girl, this choice is gonna cost you, y'know?
Go on home, loser dog!
rows.notes: Female version of c01719; Japanese 'ruuzu doggu' (Engrish 'lose dog') rendered as in the male version.

rows.en:
Fresh Girl, now it's party time!
Follow me!!
Yo, Fresh Boy.
Huh, Luis-san... What's up?

...I was waiting for you...
for you, Boy.
rows.notes: Male version; Luis shortens Fresh Boy to 'Boy'.

rows.en: Yes... That's right... That's right, indeed...

You don't get it?
What I came here to tell you...
You're saying you don't know?
S-Sorry... I have no idea at all...

...You really are one cold-fish boy!!
Is that all our relationship means to you!?
rows.notes: 'uootaa sumeru boui' = Luis's literal English for 'mizukusai' (standoffish, keeping secrets from a friend). Rendered 'cold-fish' to keep a watery joke.

rows.en: U-Um... I have no idea what's going on...

I heard the rumors, y'know...?
That you've been getting real cozy
with that woman...!
rows.notes: Shared male/female in ext_lis_003 (both genders hear 'that woman'). The woman is not named.

rows.en: Don't worry!

Even if everyone else tries to stop you,
I'll be cheering you on!!
You can only go all out for a woman while you're young!!

I'll become the wind...
So you become the wind too!!
U-Um...
Yo, Fresh Girl.

...I was waiting for you...
for you, Girl.

...You really are one cold-fish girl!!
Is that all our relationship means to you!?
Huh? Rumors? Getting cozy!?

Don't worry!
Even if everyone else tries to stop you,
I'll be cheering you on!!

But hey, once in a while...
remember me, will ya...

I heard the rumors, y'know...?
That you've been getting real cozy
with that man...!
rows.notes: ext_lis_004, both genders hear 'that man'. Not named.

rows.en:
Even if everyone else tries to stop you,
I'll be cheering you on!!
You can only go all out for a man while you're young!!
rows.notes: ext_lis_004 male version; the Japanese has 'otoko' (a man) here.

rows.en:
(Today I'm gonna work up the nerve
and ask Luca something.)
Hey, Luca!

What is it,
\p-san?

There's something I wanna ask you.
Is that okay?

Something you want to ask...?
As long as it's something I can answer.
What's on the test
The EX-Gear
His shorts
It's about the physics test...
Ah, you mean the test in our next class?
Huh!? The test is next class...?

I thought it was next week...
Wh-What do I do...
Sigh... Please get it together...
Lucaaa~ Help me~

I suppose it can't be helped...
Listen, the test covers...

...and that's it.
If you remember just that much,
you can get 60 percent.
Th-Thanks, Luca!
Whoa!
P-Please don't hug me!
Then how about a passionate kiss?
That's even worse!!
Aw, shucks.

From now on, please study on your own.
I'm not exactly free either, you know...
Okaaay.
(Luca's great at teaching, too.)

Hey, hey,
there's something I wanna ask about the EX-Gear...
Ask me anything.

What do you want to know?
The structure of the hover unit?
The anti-G design?
N-No, nothing like that...

Ah, I understand.
You mean the engine's waste heat, right? I get it.
Well, that part is...
Luca-kuuun...

...And that is why my Samson is
the finest EX-Gear there is.
*slump*...
Were you actually listening?
Y-Yeah! Of course I was...
Really?
W-Well, I'd better get going home!!

Ah, wait.
I'm not done talking yet.
(Sorry, I can't take any more~!)
Hey, why do you wear shorts, Luca?

If anything, I'd like to know why
everyone else doesn't wear shorts.
Shorts are easy to move around in, huh.
They're cold in winter, though.
Well then, shall we head home?
You're right.
rows.notes: x31 generic agreement 'sou desu ne', answering suggestions and remarks alike.

rows.en: (Huh, makes sense...)
Hey, Luca-kun!

There's something I wanna ask you,
Luca-kun~
It's about the physics test...

uncertain: c01737/c01746: Luis's 'water-smell boy/girl' (literal English for mizukusai, 'acting like a stranger') rendered 'cold-fish boy/girl'.
c01729: female 'ruuzu doggu' rendered 'loser dog' like the male 'make-doggu'.
c01739/c01750: the woman/man of the rumor is never named; ext_lis_003 says 'that woman' and ext_lis_004 'that man' for both player genders, kept literal.
c01796: x31 'sou desu ne' rendered 'You're right.' to fit both suggestions and remarks.
